channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Meta's stock drops on light revenue guidance, dwindling free cash flow
item.description: Meta issued a weaker-than-expected revenue forecast and narrowed its capex range for the year.

item.title: Microsoft beats Q4 cloud expectations as full-year Azure revenue tops $100 billion
item.description: Microsoft's backlog sat 8% taller than the previous quarter, mainly thanks to contributions from customers other than large artificial intelligence companies.

item.title: Qualcomm to raise prices during memory crunch as chipmaker issues light earnings guidance
item.description: "Cost went up, prices are going to go up," Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said in an interview.

item.title: Starbucks stock jumps as coffee giant raises full-year outlook
item.description: Starbucks posted its fourth straight quarter of same-store sales growth, as it continues a turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.

item.title: Chipotle hikes same-store sales forecast as diners return for burrito bowls
item.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill stock has fallen more than 7% this year, dragging its market value down to roughly $44 billion.

item.title: Another bank raised its CD rate to 4%. Where to lock in the best yields
item.description: Some banks are boosting yields as the Federal Reserve holds rates steady.

item.title: Divided Fed holds interest rates steady, but three members voted to hike
item.description: Despite increasing support for a rate increase, the Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-3 to leave the federal funds rate in a range between 3.5% and 3.75%.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will give Iran a 'beating' after surprise attack
item.description: Centcom in a post on X said that the attack originated from Iran, but all missiles were intercepted.

item.title: Carvana posts record quarterly profits, forecasts up to $3 billion in earnings this year
item.description: Carvana said Wednesday it expects earnings of between $2.7 billion and $3 billion this year after reporting record quarterly results for the second quarter.

item.title: Sam Altman to meet with White House's Wiles this week ahead of AI framework deadline
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is meeting with a range of senior Trump administration officials, lawmakers and economists.

item.title: Jeffrey Gundlach says the bond market is telling Warsh the Fed has to start acting on inflation
item.description: Gundlach said the divergent moves across the Treasury curve showed investors' skepticism that the Fed will ultimately follow through.

item.title: Fed meeting recap: Warsh says Fed won't hesitate to stop inflation, but bond market has doubts
item.description: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh presides over his second meeting with dissent in the air.

item.title: Hims and Hers shares fall 10% as FTC sues company over data, billing practices
item.description: The FTC sued Hims and Hers over alleged health data sharing with Meta and Snap, billing practices and subscription cancellations.

item.title: Novartis chart may soon 'complete a well-defined bullish reversal,' Cappelleri says
item.description: The Swiss drugmaker reported earnings a few days ago and, so far, has done a good job holding near its recent highs.

item.title: Todd Blanche attorney general nomination on edge as Cornyn questions Trump-IRS settlement
item.description: Sen. John Cornyn says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.

item.title: Brent oil jumps back above $90 after Trump threatens to hit Iran hard
item.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

item.title: Warren, Schiff urge SEC to probe Trump Media's paid service giving faster access to Trump's posts
item.description: Trump has frequently posted policy announcements or other newsworthy information on Truth Social that have sent global markets hurtling up or down.

item.title: Apple shares just hit a record. Here's how trader Mike Khouw is playing the move
item.description: Even as broader tech names and momentum plays have faltered, Apple has hit new all-time highs.

item.title: Nike was once China's sneaker king. Here's why its sales have fallen 30%
item.description: China was once Nike's fastest-growing region but the company has lost relevance among young consumers and ceded market share to smaller, domestic brands.

item.title: DoorDash launches in-house drone delivery program after FAA certification
item.description: The ​move marks the food-delivery company's push into autonomous delivery, reducing ⁠reliance ‌on human couriers.

item.title: Chase Sapphire Preferred's 100K bonus is ending soon: 4 reasons to apply now
item.description: Chase Sapphire Preferred's 100K bonus is ending soon: Here's how the 100,000 points could be worth roughly $2,000 in travel.

item.title: Fed keeps rates steady. The big question now: What will Microsoft and Meta say on AI capex?
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Secret Service 'illegally' surveilled Comey in Trump ‘8647’ threat case: Court filing
item.description: Ex-FBI Director James Comey says he's the subject of vindictive prosecution for posting on Instagram a photo of seashells forming the numbers "8647."

item.title: JPMorgan, Schwab and UBS manage millions in Trump's $858 million investment portfolio
item.description: JPMorgan, Schwab, UBS and Stephens Inc. are among the firms that have managed Trump's fortune in accounts worth at least $858 million, a CNBC analysis found.

item.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
item.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

item.title: FIFA is embroiled in a $20 billion World Cup controversy. Here's what's going on
item.description: UEFA – European soccer's governing body – accused FIFA of "crossing a line" and said the tournament is not its to sell.

item.title: Humana tops quarterly estimates, maintains profit outlook as medical costs stay in line
item.description: Humana maintained its 2026 adjusted profit outlook of at least $9 per share, which some analysts called a "disappointment" amid high expectations for insurers.

item.title: Procter & Gamble revenue misses estimates as volume stays unchanged
item.description: Procter & Gamble reported quarterly earnings per share that topped Wall Street's estimates, but its revenue fell short of expectations.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell will steal the spotlight from Yum Brands' earnings
item.description: Wall Street is projecting a strong second quarter for Yum Brands, but investors' focus will be on updates related to the cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell.

item.title: How a 40-year-old father launched a $1.6 billion-a-year meat snacks empire from a bankrupt Wisconsin business
item.description: Jack Link turned a bankruptcy into an opportunity to build a beef jerky empire. Four decades later, Link Snacks brings in more than $1 billion in annual sales.
